scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: prisma generate --schema=./server/prisma/schema.prisma && prisma db push --schema=./server/prisma/schema.prisma && npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
